Tired of scrolling through a massive Excel workbook in front of other people?

In this video, you’ll learn 4 fast ways to navigate large Excel files so you can jump to the right sheet instantly, build a clickable “dashboard-style” menu, and even create Name Box bookmarks you can access from anywhere in the file.

⯆ DOWNLOAD the Excel file I used in the video here: https://pages.xelplus.com/excel-navigation-file

What you’ll learn
-Secret sheet list: right-click the sheet navigation arrows to jump to any tab
-Navigation Pane (Microsoft 365): search sheets and workbook elements in seconds
-Clickable Excel navigation dashboard: use hyperlinks to turn a summary sheet into a menu (plus a “back to summary” button)
-Name Box bookmarks: name key cells so you can teleport there by typing a name
-Useful Excel keyboard shortcuts
